h1. DependencyTrack Stack Installation & Deployment Guide

This guide covers the complete installation and deployment of the DependencyTrack stack with PostgreSQL, Borgmatic backups, LDAP authentication, Caddy reverse proxy, and supporting services.

h2. Architecture Overview

* *Services*: PostgreSQL, DependencyTrack API Server, Frontend, Swagger Editor/UI, Borgmatic backup, Caddy reverse proxy, Watchtower auto-updates
* *Orchestration*: Docker Swarm (single manager node)
* *Networking*: External overlay network ({{dtrack-network}})
* *Storage*: External volumes for data persistence
* *Security*: Encrypted secrets, LDAP/AD authentication, TLS via Caddy

h2. Prerequisites

* Docker Engine with Swarm enabled
* Deployment server: {{s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com}}
* Network share mounted at {{/mnt/borg-repository}} (for backups)
* LDAP/Active Directory credentials
* OpenSSL for secret encryption

h2. Step 1: Prepare Secrets

h3. Create Secret Files

Create the following unencrypted secret files in the project root:

bc.
# Create db_password file
echo "your-postgres-password" > db_password

# Create admin_password file
echo "your-admin-password" > admin_password

# Keep .env with all variables
cat > .env << 'EOF'
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=your-postgres-password
LDAP_SERVER_URL=ldaps://ldap-server:636
LDAP_BASEDN=dc=example,dc=com
LDAP_BIND_USERNAME=ldap-bind-user
LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD=ldap-bind-password
LDAP_AUTH_USERNAME_FORMAT=%s@example.com
LDAP_ATTRIBUTE_NAME=userPrincipalName
LDAP_ATTRIBUTE_MAIL=mail
LDAP_GROUPS_BASEDN=ou=Groups,dc=example,dc=com
LDAP_GROUPS_FILTER=(& (objectClass=group)(objectCategory=Group))
LDAP_USER_GROUPS_FILTER=(member: 1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941:={USER_DN})
BORG_PASSPHRASE=your-borgmatic-passphrase
EOF

h3. Encrypt Secrets Before Deployment

Use the {{secret_encryptor.sh}} script to encrypt sensitive files:

bc.
./resources/scripts/secret_encryptor.sh encrypt db_password admin_password .env

This creates encrypted versions:
* {{db_password.enc}}
* {{admin_password.enc}}
* {{.env.enc}}

The script uses AES-256-CBC encryption. You will be prompted for a passphrase.

h3. Transfer Encrypted Files to Deployment Server

bc.
scp db_password.enc admin_password.enc .env.enc deploy@s-track-01:/tmp/

h3. Decrypt on Deployment Server

bc.
ssh deploy@s-track-01

# From /tmp
./secret_encryptor.sh decrypt db_password.enc admin_password.enc .env.enc

# Move to deployment directory
mv db_password admin_password .env ~/sbom-uploader/
cd ~/sbom-uploader

# Secure the directory
chmod 700 .

# Verify secrets are in place
cat db_password
cat .env

h2. Step 2: Initialize Docker Swarm

If not already initialized:

bc.
docker swarm init

Verify:
bc.
docker swarm ls

h2. Step 3: Create External Resources

h3. Create Docker Secrets

These are mounted at {{/run/secrets/}} and injected into containers:

bc.
docker secret create db_password db_password
docker secret create admin_password admin_password

Verify:
bc.
docker secret ls

h3. Create External Volumes

bc.
docker volume create dtrack_postgres_data
docker volume create dtrack_apiserver_data
docker volume create swagger

Verify:
bc.
docker volume ls

h3. Create External Network

bc.
docker network create --driver overlay dtrack-network

Verify:
bc.
docker network ls

h2. Step 4: Configure Deployment

h3. Update Caddyfile

Configure reverse proxy with your TLS certificate:

bc.
{
  email your-email@example.com
}

s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com {
  reverse_proxy /api/* dependency-track-apiserver:8080
  reverse_proxy dependency-track-frontend:80
  reverse_proxy /swagger/* swagger-ui:8080

  encode gzip
}

h3. Update Borgmatic Config

Ensure {{borgmatic-config.yaml}} is in the project root and references:

bc.
repositories:
  - label: postgres_backup
    path: /mnt/borg-repository
    passcommand: cat /run/secrets/borg_passphrase

postgresql_databases:
  - name: dtrack
    hostname: postgres
    port: 5432
    username: dtrack
    password_command: cat /run/secrets/db_password

h3. Prepare TLS Certificates

If using self-signed certificates:

bc.
mkdir -p certs
openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem \
  -subj "/CN=s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com"

h2. Step 5: Deploy the Stack

h3. Deploy Services

bc.
docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.yml dtrack

Monitor deployment:
bc.
docker stack ps dtrack

h3. Verify Services Are Running

bc.
docker service ls

Check logs:
bc.
docker service logs dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver
docker service logs dtrack_postgres
docker service logs dtrack_borgmatic

h2. Step 6: Backup and Restore Procedures

h3. Backup All Volumes

Use the {{backup-and-restore-volume.sh}} script to backup Docker volumes:

bc.
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh backup-all ~/backups/volumes

This creates:
* {{~/backups/volumes/dtrack_postgres_data.tar.gz}}
* {{~/backups/volumes/dtrack_apiserver_data.tar.gz}}
* {{~/backups/volumes/swagger.tar.gz}}

h3. Backup Specific Volume

bc.
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh backup dtrack_postgres_data ~/backups/volumes

h3. Restore All Volumes

bc.
# Stop services first
docker stack rm dtrack

# Restore volumes
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh restore-all ~/backups/volumes

# Redeploy stack
docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.yml dtrack

h3. Restore Specific Volume

bc.
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh restore dtrack_postgres_data ~/backups/volumes

h2. Step 7: Automated Backups with Borgmatic

The Borgmatic service runs on the Swarm and performs:
* Logical PostgreSQL backups via {{pg_dump}}
* Automatic encryption with {{BORG_PASSPHRASE}}
* Retention: 7 daily, 4 weekly, 12 monthly backups
* Backup location: {{/mnt/borg-repository}}

Monitor Borgmatic:
bc.
docker service logs dtrack_borgmatic

h2. Step 8: Configure LDAP Authentication

DependencyTrack automatically syncs users and teams from LDAP/AD based on {{.env}} variables:

* {{LDAP_SERVER_URL}}: LDAPS endpoint
* {{LDAP_BASEDN}}: Search base DN
* {{LDAP_BIND_USERNAME}}: Service account credentials
* {{LDAP_USER_GROUPS_FILTER}}: User group membership query
* {{LDAP_TEAMS_SYNCHRONIZATION}}: Enabled

Verify LDAP login:
bc.
# Navigate to https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com
# Use your AD credentials to login

h2. Step 9: Security Hardening

h3. Post-Deployment Secret Destruction

After stack is running, destroy unencrypted secrets:

bc.
# On deployment server
rm -f db_password admin_password .env
chmod 700 /home/deploy/sbom-uploader

# Verify secrets are removed
ls -la db_password  # Should fail

Secrets remain in Docker Swarm at {{/run/secrets/}} inside containers.

h3. Restrict Directory Access

bc.
sudo chown root:root ~/sbom-uploader
sudo chmod 700 ~/sbom-uploader

Only root can read deployment files.

h2. Step 10: Monitoring and Verification

h3. Check Service Health

bc.
docker stack ps dtrack

h3. View Service Logs

bc.
# API Server
docker service logs dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver --follow

# PostgreSQL
docker service logs dtrack_postgres --follow

# Borgmatic
docker service logs dtrack_borgmatic --follow

h3. Access Web Interfaces

* *DependencyTrack UI*: https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com
* *Swagger Editor*: https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com/swagger-editor
* *Swagger UI*: https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com/swagger-ui

h3. Verify PostgreSQL

bc.
docker exec dtrack_postgres pg_isready -U dtrack

h2. Troubleshooting

h3. Service Fails to Start

bc.
# Check for errors
docker service logs dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver
docker service ps dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver

# Restart service
docker service update --force dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver

h3. Database Connection Failed

bc.
# Verify postgres is healthy
docker service ps dtrack_postgres

# Check logs
docker service logs dtrack_postgres

# Verify network connectivity
docker exec dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver \
  pg_isready -h postgres -U dtrack

h3. Backup Directory Not Accessible

bc.
# Verify mount
mount | grep borg-repository

# If not mounted
sudo mount -t nfs <server>:<path> /mnt/borg-repository
sudo chmod 700 /mnt/borg-repository

h3. Borgmatic Backup Fails

bc.
# Check Borgmatic logs
docker service logs dtrack_borgmatic

# Manually test backup command
docker exec dtrack_borgmatic borgmatic --verbosity 2

h2. Volume Recovery Example

Complete workflow to backup and restore volumes:

bc.
# 1. Backup all volumes
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh backup-all /mnt/nas/backups

# 2. Verify backups
ls -lh /mnt/nas/backups/

# 3. If disaster occurs, stop stack
docker stack rm dtrack

# 4. Restore volumes
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh restore-all /mnt/nas/backups

# 5. Redeploy stack
docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.yml dtrack

# 6. Verify services
docker service ls

h2. Security Model Summary

* *Secrets*: Encrypted locally with AES-256, transferred securely to deployment server
* *Storage*: Destroyed after deployment; Docker Swarm secrets remain available to containers
* *Access*: Deployment directory root-only (chmod 700)
* *Transport*: TLS via Caddy reverse proxy
* *Authentication*: LDAP/AD integration for user provisioning
* *Backups*: Encrypted with BORG_PASSPHRASE; stored on network share

h2. Maintenance Tasks

h3. Update Services

Watchtower automatically updates services on schedule. To manually update:

bc.
docker pull dependencytrack/apiserver:latest
docker service update --image dependencytrack/apiserver:latest dtrack_dependency-track-apiserver

h3. Rotate Secrets

bc.
# Update db_password
echo "new-password" > db_password
docker secret rm db_password
docker secret create db_password db_password

# Restart postgres service
docker service update --force dtrack_postgres

h3. Rotate Backup Encryption

bc.
# Update BORG_PASSPHRASE in secrets
# Note: Existing backups remain encrypted with old passphrase
# New backups use new passphrase
